name: @kroma/release-tools
description: A project-agnostic, testable toolkit for Conventional-Commit releases: derive per-package SemVer bumps and changelog entries, write them into native manifests (Cargo.toml / package.json / any JSON), and optionally summarise via a local CLI agent. Layered so the core carries no git, filesystem or project specifics.
author: Maxime Scharwath <maxscharwath@gmail.com>
